# Mapper and downstream carrier bindings

Four independently authored Object method formals retain a mapper input/output,
downstream input/accumulator/result and the output carrier's input/result slots.
Its unbounded middle slot binds nothing. The opaque factory records original
references and returns a late-selected carrier without invoking the mapper.

Owned calls to real SDK mapping preserve downstream accessor order, captured
functions and characteristics, mapper/accumulator sequencing, opaque nullable
states and exact partial failures. Source and SDK profiles compile every Java8
unit and retain original definitions, roles, Signatures, Exceptions and helpers.
Independent wrong programs precede recovery; metadata controls preserve Code.
